test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. People post images of their cuisine, daily cosmetic routines, shopping videos, and dance videos.

B. Uploading photos to social networking sites has grown popular in today's society.

C. Because of the rising influence of social media on people, they want to constantly appear their best.

D. Therefore people have become more image sensors and begun to prioritise personal care.
solution:
The correct answer is "**BACD**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about **social media's influence on people**.
 
• **Social media** is about** uploading** photos, so "**B**" will come as its **first** sentence.
 
• Next, the **type of posts** should be discussed and "**A**" is the next sentence.
 
• **"C"** is the next sentence as it contains the matter of the text, that is the** influence of social media on people.**
 
• "**D**" is the final sentence as it gives a **conclusion**. Moreover, the word "**Therefore**" also gives a **hint** that it will be the** last sentence **of the stanza. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Certain **rules** must be followed to** arrange sentences** in order to frame a **meaningful stanza**.
 
• The first step is to **read all the sentences** and understand their meaning.
 
• Next, try to find the **theme** of the stanza.
 
• There will be a** link between each sentence**. Try to identify them.
 
• **Connecting words** like "although", "therefore", etc will help in ordering them. 
 
• Understanding the **opening sentence and closing sentence** will make this process easier.
